title: Property Estimation in Geotechnical Databases Using Labeled Random Finite Sets
abstract: arXiv:2410.22659v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: The sufficiency of accurate data is a core element in data-centric geotechnics. However, geotechnical datasets are essentially uncertain, whereupon engineers have difficulty with obtaining precise information for making decisions. This challenge is more apparent when the performance of data-driven technologies solely relies on imperfect databases or even when it is sometimes difficult to investigate sites physically. This paper introduces geotechnical property estimation from noisy and incomplete data within the labeled random finite set (LRFS) framework. We leverage the ability of the generalized labeled multi-Bernoulli (GLMB) filter, a fundamental solution for multi-object estimation, to deal with measurement uncertainties from a Bayesian perspective. translated_title: 基于标记随机有限集的岩土数据库土性参数估计
translated_abstract: 充足且准确的数据是数据中心岩土工程学的核心要素。然而，岩土数据集本质上具有不确定性，这使得工程师难以获得精确的信息来支持决策。当数据驱动技术的性能完全依赖于不完善的数据库，或者有时难以对场地进行实地勘察时，这一挑战显得尤为突出。本文在标记随机有限集（LRFS）框架内提出了从含噪声和不完整数据中进行岩土特性估计的方法。我们利用广义标记多伯努利（GLMB）滤波器——多目标估计问题的一种基础解决方案——从贝叶斯视角处理测量不确定性。特别是，本工作重点关注了LRFS与岩土工程中大型间接数据（BID）之间的相似性，由于两者的特征彼此相近，这使得GLMB滤波能够（应用于岩土特性估计）。
tldr: 本文提出在标记随机有限集（LRFS）框架下，利用广义标记多伯努利（GLMB）滤波器从贝叶斯视角处理含噪声和不完整的岩土数据，实现了岩土数据库中的土性参数估计。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes geotechnical property estimation from noisy and incomplete data by leveraging the GLMB filter within the labeled random finite set (LRFS) framework, handling measurement uncertainties from a Bayesian perspective.
